description: Use this skill when the user wants to add SolvaPay to an app they already have — gate or charge existing endpoints, meter usage, handle webhooks, embed billing/account UI (plan status, manage-billing button); Next.js/React/Express/edge runtimes plus wiring an existing MCP server; even when they only describe the outcome. Do not use for building a new MCP server from scratch (solvapay/create-mcp-app), Lovable preview checkout (solvapay/lovable-checkout), or hosted-checkout-only redirect flows (solvapay/website-checkout).
